messages.subject: New Version of Deducer released
parts:
Hi All,

Version 0.4-3 of Deducer is released and making its way to all the
CRAN mirrors. There has been a lot of refactoring of the Data Viewer
code, so please let me know if you encounter any bugs.


Changes:
1. Fixed bugs in some of the advanced options in the plot builder
   (thanks to Erich Studerus for the bug reports)
2. Data viewer size restricted to screen size
3. Added k-sample post-hoc comparisons
4. Factored back end to make it easier to plug deducer into different consoles
5. Refactored the Data viewer to be plug-in friendly
6. Added sort to data view column contextual menus
7. Added Links to manual/videos in the default data viewer panel


Best,
Ian
